limits: Synthetic engineering files exercise real filesystem and archive operations; no model training, Torch forward or held-out scoring is invoked
The study loop integration changes storage only and is reviewed structurally; model execution is not part of this qualification
New producer writes scores for every selected/gate checkpoint; older runs with no index cannot supply previously unsaved gate scores
No source is deployed onto an active host and no running experiment is restarted
registered_controls: Physical tar roundtrip retains every checkpoint, each actually scored selection and unchanged arrays
Missing, altered or incompletely indexed scores refuse publication
Sealed checkpoint must be in the verified history
Legacy originals remain available, with absent historical gate scores left absent
Exact resumed score writes are idempotent and conflicting bytes cannot replace originals
